secrets.contents: ssh, gnupg, gh token, ssl cert key, app signing keys, /etc/shadow, /etc/gshadow, bash_history

userdata.contents: browser profiles (no caches), agent/app state, unique files >8MB

excluded_by_policy: core dumps (*/core) — huge, leak process memory
caches: ~/.cache, Cache/, Code Cache/, GPUCache/, Service Worker/, component_crx_cache/
